WITH state_base AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(TRIM(c.state_county_province), '') AS state,
         COUNT(a.account_id) AS account_count
  FROM Customers c
  LEFT JOIN Accounts a ON a.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY NULLIF(TRIM(c.state_county_province), '')
),
shares AS (
  SELECT state,
         account_count,
         account_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(account_count) OVER (), 0) AS share
  FROM state_base
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM shares
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT s.share, s.account_count, a.avg_share
  FROM shares s
  CROSS JOIN avg_share a
  WHERE s.share > a.avg_share
)
SELECT SUM(account_count) AS combined_account_base,
       AVG(share) AS average_share,
       AVG(share - avg_share) AS average_excess_share
FROM above_avg;
